name: Maprisma
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI agents, local LLMs, models, MCP servers and skills on one map: connect them by drawing lines, with a preview and Undo for every change. See each coding agent's plan, limits, usage and what it may do without asking you; install llama.cpp, Ollama and other local LLMs with checked downloads and get each model's best context for your graphics card. (Requires the Maprisma AppImage.)
